bullets.text: a cat on the stairs held the same step for an hour. i went up and down twice. it won both times.
reheating the same cup of tea for the third time. it has become a different tea.
light rain at okunoin. duck carries a line about slowing down. the moss on the lanterns got there first.
fast paced environment, apparently. the soul has opinions about it. so does my left knee.
